1 _______________________________________________________ Hon'ble Shri Justice P. Sam Koshy Order on Board [13/01/2023]
1. Grievance of the Petitioners in the present Writ Petition seems to be the non-granting of interest to the amount of compensation quantified in accordance with the Award passed under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (in short, "the 2013 Act").
2. Learned Counsel for Petitioners submits that the Award in the instant case was passed on 15.9.2022 by Respondent No.4.

sentences.text: However, the compensation does not reflect payment of interest to the Petitioners.

The Petitioners have the right to claim interest from the date of dispossession which in the instant case was of 1.8.2011 when the property belonging to the Petitioners was taken over by the Respondents for the purpose of construction of Saradih Bairaj through Village Nawapara, Tahsil Dabhra, District Sakti where the Petitioners had their land which stood acquired.
3. Learned Counsel for Petitioners further submits that the Petitioners have already approached the Respondent No.3 by moving an application under Section 73 as also under Section 80 of the 2013 Act.
However, there has been no further development in this regard.
4. The said application was filed by the Petitioners on 15.12.2022 and the present Writ Petition has been filed seeking for a direction of an early decision on the same.
5. Learned State Counsel submits that it is just around 15 days' time that the Petitioners have approached the Respondent No.3.
It is too early for the Writ Court for issuance of any direction to Respondent No.3.

The Respondent No.3 otherwise also in terms of the 2013 Act has to decide the same in accordance with law, after hearing all the parties and taking into consideration the submissions that the Petitioners have made in their application.

6. Given the said facts and circumstances of the case, this Court thus finds that the Petitioners have approached this Court at too early a stage, i.e., barely after 15 days' time, by moving the said application before the Competent Authority.

Nonetheless, now that the Petitioners have come to this Court, the present Writ Petition as of now stands disposed of directing the Respondent No.3 to take an appropriate decision on the claim of the Petitioners so far as granting of interest from the date of dispossession is concerned, at the earliest, preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of copy of this Order.
7. The Writ Petition accordingly stands disposed of.

Sd/-
 (P. Sam Koshy)
